cues.zh: 什么，那个愚蠢的宏伟计划？Bernard，那恰恰是你必须避免的。
cues.en: What, that silly grand design? Bernard, that was precisely what you had to avoid.

cues.zh: 这是怎么发生的？我需要一个很好的解释。
cues.en: How did this come about? I shall need a very good explanation.

cues.zh: - 嗯，他非常热衷于这个。
cues.en: - Well, he's very keen on it.

cues.zh: - 那跟这有什么关系？
cues.en: - What's that got to do with it?

cues.zh: 事情不会因为首相们非常热衷就发生。
cues.en: Things don't happen just because prime ministers are very keen on them.

cues.zh: Neville Chamberlain非常热衷于和平。
cues.en: Neville Chamberlain was very keen on peace.

cues.zh: - 你看，他认为……他认为这能赢得选票。
cues.en: - You see, he thinks... He thinks it's a vote winner.
- Ah.

cues.zh: 那就更严重了。坐下吧。
cues.en: That's more serious. Sit down.

cues.zh: 他为什么会这么想？
cues.en: What makes him think that?

cues.zh: - 嗯，党做了一次民意调查。看起来
cues.en: - Well, the party have had an opinion poll done. It seems

cues.zh: 所有选民都支持恢复国民服役制度。
cues.en: all the voters are in favour of bringing back National Service.

cues.zh: - 那就再做一次民意调查，显示选民反对恢复国民服役制度。
cues.en: - Well, have another opinion poll done showing the voters are against bringing back National Service.

cues.zh: - 我们不能既支持又反对。
cues.en: - We can't be for it and against it.

cues.zh: - 哦，他们当然可以，Bernard。你被调查过吗？
cues.en: - Oh, of course they can, Bernard. Have you ever been surveyed?

cues.zh: - 是的。嗯，其实不是我，是我的房子。
cues.en: - Yes. Well, not me actually, my house.

cues.zh: 哦，我明白你的意思了。
cues.en: Oh, I see what you mean.

cues.zh: - Bernard，你知道会发生什么。一位漂亮的年轻女士走到你面前。显然你
cues.en: - Bernard, you know what happens. A nice, young lady comes up to you. Obviously you

cues.zh: 想给人留下好印象。你不想显得像个傻瓜，对吧？
cues.en: want to create a good impression. You don't want to look a fool, do you?

cues.zh: - 不想。
cues.en: - No.

cues.zh: - 不想。于是她开始问你一些问题。
cues.en: - No. So she starts asking you some questions.

cues.zh: Woolley先生，你担心年轻人失业的人数吗？
cues.en: Mr Woolley, are you worried about the number of young people without jobs?

cues.zh: - 担心。
cues.en: - Yes.

cues.zh: - 你担心青少年犯罪率上升吗？
cues.en: - Are you worried about the rise in crime among teenagers?

cues.zh: - 担心。
cues.en: - Yes.

cues.zh: - 你觉得我们的综合中学缺乏纪律吗？
cues.en: - Do you think there's a lack of discipline in our comprehensive schools?

cues.zh: - 是的。
cues.en: - Yes.

cues.zh: - 你觉得年轻人在生活中欢迎一些权威和领导吗？
cues.en: - Do you think young people welcome some authority and leadership in their lives?

cues.zh: - 是的。
cues.en: - Yes.

cues.zh: - 你觉得他们会回应挑战吗？
cues.en: - Do you think they respond to a challenge?

cues.zh: - 会的。
cues.en: - Yes.

cues.zh: - 你赞成重新实行国民服役吗？
cues.en: - Would you be in favour of reintroducing National Service?

cues.zh: - 我……哦，嗯，我想我可能会吧。
cues.en: - Y… Oh, well, I suppose I might be.

cues.zh: - 是还是不是？
cues.en: - Yes or no?
- Yes.

cues.zh: - 你当然会答应，伯纳德。毕竟你都告诉她了，你没法拒绝她这个要求。
cues.en: - Of course you would, Bernard. After all you've told her you can't say no to that.

cues.zh: 所以，他们不提头五个问题，只刊登最后一个。
cues.en: So they don't mention the first five questions and they publish the last one.

cues.zh: - 他们真会这么做？
cues.en: - Is that really what they do?

cues.zh: - 嗯，信誉好的媒体不会。但这样的媒体不多。
cues.en: - Well, not the reputable ones, no. But there aren't many of those.

cues.zh: 所以，这位年轻女士也可以得到相反的结果。
cues.en: So, alternatively, the young lady can get the opposite result.

cues.zh: - 怎么做？
cues.en: - How?

cues.zh: - 伍利先生，您担心战争的危险吗？
cues.en: - Mr Woolley, are you worried about the danger of war?
- Yes.

cues.zh: - 您担心军备扩张吗？
cues.en: - Are you worried about the growth of armaments?
- Yes.

cues.zh: - 您觉得给年轻人枪，还教他们杀人，会不会有危险？
cues.en: - Do you think there's a danger in giving young people guns and teaching them how to kill?
- Yes.

cues.zh: - 您觉得强迫人们违背意愿拿起武器是错的吗？
cues.en: - Do you think it's wrong to force people to take up arms against their will?
- Yes.

cues.zh: - 您反对恢复义务兵役制吗？
cues.en: - Would you oppose the reintroduction of National Service?
- Yes.

cues.zh: 你看，这不就有了吗，伯纳德。
cues.en: - There you are, you see, Bernard.

cues.zh: 完美的均衡样本。
cues.en: The perfect balanced sample.

cues.zh: 那我们就为国防部委托做一份自己的调查。
cues.en: So, we just commission our own survey for the Ministry of Defence.

cues.zh: 这事就交给你了，伯纳德。
cues.en: See to it, Bernard.

cues.zh: - 可广播的事怎么办？
cues.en: - Yes, but what about the broadcast?

cues.zh: - 他打算什么时候播？
cues.en: - When's he expecting to do it?

cues.zh: - 我不知道。我想，大概下个月某个时候吧。
cues.en: - I don't know. Sometime next month, I suppose.

cues.zh: - 那你就告诉他，11天后播。
cues.en: - Well, perhaps you'll tell him it'll be in 11 days' time.

cues.zh: - 11天后？有点太赶了。万一他拒绝呢？
cues.en: - Eleven days? That's a bit soon. Suppose he refuses.

cues.zh: - 那你就告诉他，我们刚从联合广播委员会得知，
cues.en: - Well then you can tell him that we just learned from the Joint Broadcasting Committee

cues.zh: 反对党将在18天后举行党派政治广播，
cues.en: that the Opposition will be holding a party political in 18 days' time

cues.zh: 而他有权先播他的部长级广播。
cues.en: and he's entitled to get his ministerial in first.

cues.zh: 当然，如果他希望自己担任首相后的第一次政治广播由反对党来播，
cues.en: Of course, if he wishes the first political broadcast of his

cues.zh: 那也没问题。
cues.en: premiership to be given by the Opposition that's fine.

cues.zh: - 呃，这是真的吗？
cues.en: - Um, is that true?

cues.zh: - 会是这样的。
cues.en: - It will be.

cues.zh: 如果你到明天都不提的话。
cues.en: If you don't mention it till tomorrow.

cues.zh: - 但他仍然可以宣布他的新政策。
cues.en: - But he could still announce his new policy.

cues.zh: - 我不这么认为，Bernard。
cues.en: - I don't think so, Bernard.

cues.zh: 他只会和内阁同僚开一次会
cues.en: He'll have only one meeting with his Cabinet

cues.zh: 在海外政策与国防委员会上把它敲定。
cues.en: colleagues in the Overseas Policy and Defence Committee to clear it.

cues.zh: - 我了解到他所有的内阁同僚都支持它。
cues.en: - I understand all his Cabinet colleagues are in favour of it.

cues.zh: - 是的，但只是个人层面，Bernard。只是政治上。但他们在官方层面支持吗？
cues.en: - Yes, but only personally, Bernard. Only politically. But are they in favour officially?

cues.zh: 作为负责任的部门大臣？
cues.en: As responsible departmental ministers?

cues.zh: - 哦，我明白了。那得看他们得到的建议了，是吧？
cues.en: - Oh, I see. I suppose that will depend on the advice they get, will it?
